info.name: Auth0 Authentication actions Deprecated > Authenticate API
Auth0 Login Using a Social Provider's Access Token

items.docs: Given the social provider's access_token and the connection specified, it will do the authentication on the provider and return a JSON with the access_token and id_token. Currently, this endpoint only works for Facebook, Google, Twitter and Weibo. **This endpoint has been deprecated**.

info.name: Auth0 [Deprecated] Return a User Profile Based on the User's JWT

items.docs: Validates a JSON Web Token (signature and expiration) and returns the user information associated with the user id (sub property) of the token.
